name: Dual Claude Coding
description: Two Claude agents pair-program: a Driver plans and reviews while a Navigator implements and tests. Uses a self-feeding relay loop with role-switching.
author: AionUi

descriptionI18n.en-US: Two Claude agents pair-program: a Driver plans and reviews while a Navigator implements and tests. Ideal for complex tasks that benefit from planning and review.
descriptionI18n.zh-CN: 两个 Claude 代理结对编程：Driver 负责规划和审查，Navigator 负责实现和测试。适用于需要规划和审查的复杂任务。

en-US: Refactor the authentication module to use JWT tokens
Add comprehensive error handling to the API layer
Implement a caching system for database queries
Set up a test suite for the user management module
zh-CN: 将认证模块重构为使用 JWT 令牌
为 API 层添加完善的错误处理
为数据库查询实现缓存系统
为用户管理模块建立测试套件

queuedMessages.description: Driver/Navigator relay: onQueueInit seeds the Driver's first planning turn, onAgentResponse alternates between Driver and Navigator roles via <handoff> tags until <done/> is signalled.

phases.purpose: Seed the Driver's initial planning turn
Relay between Driver and Navigator roles
